Water discharge by destination and level of treatment (in kilolitres)

The Company is committed to responsible water management and conservation across its manufacturing operations. Water is primarily utilized in CNC machining processes, cleaning activities, and domestic purposes. The manufacturing processes are designed to optimize water usage through efficient operational practices and recirculation, wherever feasible. The Company does not discharge any wastewater from its manufacturing operations, and there is no release of wastewater to surface water bodies, groundwater, or third-party facilities. Water used in the manufacturing process is consumed, reused, evaporated, or otherwise retained within the process cycle.
